ImageDescription.value:
February 2004 - We wanted to spend some time in Victoria, BC. We'd visited plenty of times but never really did the touristy things. So we went to the Royal BC Museum, the Wax Museum, and toured the Provincial Parliament. Just getting there, via a BC Ferry is usually interesting. We spent three nights in a hotel.

To read blog entries for this period of time, please visit <a target="`_new``" href="http://www.dennissylvesterhurd.com/blog/2004_02_08_vault.html#107628709638917929">my eJournal and images: 02.08.2004</a>. (Many of the same photos exist there too.)
